patch_list: Keep player controls during live ads
Stops the app from hiding the player controls when a live ad starts, so you can seek past it.
Bypasses DAION and plays the plain live URL. May not work if the server rejects it.
Removes Google Ad Manager banners across the NOW app.
Disables IMA/VMAP pre-roll and mid-roll ads in on-demand videos.
